requirements.quote:
Endpoints in either role MUST NOT decrypt 1-RTT packets from
   their peer prior to completing the handshake.
requirements.condition: Before an endpoint in either role completes its TLS handshake.
requirements.required_behavior: Defer decryption of peer 1-RTT packets until handshake completion.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not decrypt any 1-RTT packet received from the peer.
requirements.error_behavior: Retain or otherwise defer an early packet only as allowed; do not expose decrypted contents before handshake completion.
requirements.why_checkable: An early peer 1-RTT packet can be delivered while decryption-call instrumentation verifies that no decryption occurs before the completion event.

requirements.quote:
Therefore, the server's use of 1-RTT keys before the handshake is
   complete is limited to sending data.
requirements.condition: When a server possesses 1-RTT keys before its TLS handshake is complete.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the 1-RTT keys only to protect outgoing data.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use pre-completion 1-RTT keys for receiving or decrypting peer data.
requirements.why_checkable: Key-use instrumentation can classify every pre-completion 1-RTT operation as send-side or receive-side.

requirements.quote:
A server MUST NOT process
   incoming 1-RTT protected packets before the TLS handshake is
   complete.
requirements.condition: Before the TLS handshake is complete at a server.
requirements.required_behavior: Defer processing of incoming 1-RTT protected packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not process frames or otherwise act on contents of an incoming 1-RTT protected packet.
requirements.error_behavior: Store the packet for later processing only if the implementation chooses the permitted buffering behavior.
requirements.why_checkable: An early incoming 1-RTT packet can be injected and server frame-processing callbacks observed before and after handshake completion.

requirements.quote:
Because sending acknowledgments indicates that all frames
   in a packet have been processed, a server cannot send acknowledgments
   for 1-RTT packets until the TLS handshake is complete.
requirements.condition: Before the TLS handshake is complete at a server that has received a 1-RTT packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not send an acknowledgment covering the 1-RTT packet.
requirements.why_checkable: ACK frames sent before server handshake completion can be decoded to determine whether they cover packet numbers of received 1-RTT packets.

requirements.quote:
Received
   packets protected with 1-RTT keys MAY be stored and later decrypted
   and used once the handshake is complete.
requirements.condition: When a 1-RTT protected packet arrives before handshake completion.
requirements.required_behavior: Permit the endpoint to store the packet and defer decryption and use until the handshake is complete.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not reject an implementation solely because it buffers the intact packet for post-completion processing.
requirements.error_behavior: If retained, keep the packet unprocessed until handshake completion.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver an early 1-RTT packet, observe buffering without decryption, complete the handshake, and then observe decryption and use.

requirements.quote:
A server could receive packets protected with 0-RTT keys prior to
   receiving a TLS ClientHello.  The server MAY retain these packets for
   later decryption in anticipation of receiving a ClientHello.
requirements.condition: When a server receives a 0-RTT protected packet before receiving the TLS ClientHello needed to derive or select the corresponding keys.
requirements.required_behavior: Permit the server to retain the packet for later decryption after the ClientHello arrives.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not reject an implementation solely because it buffers the early 0-RTT packet instead of immediately discarding it.
requirements.error_behavior: Do not attempt to decrypt the retained packet until the information needed from ClientHello is available.
requirements.why_checkable: A 0-RTT packet can be reordered ahead of ClientHello and the server observed for retention followed by later decryption.

requirements.quote:
Even if it has 1-RTT secrets, a client MUST NOT
   process incoming 1-RTT protected packets before the TLS handshake is
   complete.
requirements.condition: Before the TLS handshake is complete at a client, even if the client already has 1-RTT secrets.
requirements.required_behavior: Defer processing of incoming 1-RTT protected packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not process frames or otherwise act on contents of an incoming 1-RTT protected packet.
requirements.why_checkable: A client can be given 1-RTT secrets and an incoming 1-RTT packet before completion while frame-processing callbacks are monitored.
